notes: «عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ الصَّفَّارِ» follows «حَدَّثَنِی مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْحَسَنِ» directly with «عَنْ» each time: the same man written twice in succession, one link, the fuller form (rule 7); the next «محمد بن الحسن» is a separate link
«قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ع يَقُولُ»: the Imam is named only in the words after the chain, so he is the last link, kind imam_in_text (owner ruling 2)
